targets.note: NOT `main`. Another session owns this branch and was editing branches/ and contracts/ during detection. Plan writes no source, so this is recorded rather than blocking - but Preview and Apply inherit it, and the owner should confirm the branch before either runs.

references.purpose: src/components/pages/PracticeHubPage (PracticeRail, ProgressCockpit, PracticeFilters, ProblemCatalog, CodingLeaderboard) and src/components/pages/PracticeProblemPage; route /[locale]/practice
graphql domain `coding`: 8 queries and 2 mutations, CodingProblemEntity, CodingSubmissionEntity, CodingDifficulty, CodingDomain, CodingLanguage, CodingVerdict

scopeDecision: One case, two work items and one direction system: the practice hub and the problem-solving page. Chosen by the owner over a single-page scope.
editorDecision: CodeMirror 6, chosen by the owner over Monaco. The new frontend carries NO editor and NO socket client today; the legacy app carries both.
